reviews.text: I cannot speak highly enough of Molly. I took my chow chow today for a full groom. He can sometimes be anxious due to a bad experience at another groomers. Molly took her time and built such a lovely rapport with him. She even managed to blow dry all his face/ears and have his under paws clipped (he has never allowed any groomer to do that) She has groomed him to perfection and the whole experience was stress free. I can't thank you enough Molly.
Fantastic with my German Shepherd 😀 would highly recommend!

I took my fur baby on recommendation of a friend  for his first groom at Mrs Bs Dog Grooming today.He came back exactly how I like him.I will definitely be booking my best friend  in again with you .Rufus will see you in 8weeks time please

I honestly can’t recommend Mrs. B’s enough!

Training with Steph and Katie has been an absolute pleasure from start to finish. If it wasn’t for the patience, kindness, and encouragement they showed me throughout my three weeks of training, I genuinely don’t think I would have progressed as much as I have in an area I’ve been so passionate about developing in.

I’ve attended several training academies in the past, but none of them lived up to my expectations. Because of those experiences, I was quite sceptical about booking here. I decided to attend one of their open events first, and from the moment I walked in, I loved the atmosphere. Everyone was so welcoming, supportive, and professional that I knew it was the right place for me.

What really sets this academy apart is that the training is genuinely enjoyable. Steph and Katie make learning fun while still maintaining incredibly high standards, which makes such a difference. They take the time to explain everything clearly, build your confidence, and truly want you to succeed.

I’m leaving with so much more knowledge, confidence, and enthusiasm than I arrived with. Thank you both for an amazing experience—I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend you to anyone looking to further their skills!

I have just finished my level 3 iPet with the grooming academy and have to send a glowing review!

Mel and John are absolutely wonderful, such warm and supportive people and thank you for convincing me to do the course it’s definitely been one of the best experiences I’ve ever had 🐾 This leads me on to the course trainers Becky, Katie and Steph who are absolutely incredible people and talented dog groomers and all help create such a positive, fun and enjoyable environment to learn in. They truly have made the last three weeks such a joy so a massive thank you to you all ♥️
Brillant thanks so much couldn't ask for better
Thank you Auntie Dawn, I feel ace

Fantastic service today. I used Mrs B’s today for the 1st time for my gorgeous girl Millie. They were so friendly and beautiful with my little girl. She looks incredible and we have booked again for our next groom. Thank you for your patience and time. X
